challenge.better_approach: Auto-take a scratch bus for a foreign root: quieter, but a hollow or worktree proof reading live bus state would then silently read an empty throwaway table and could green hollow. Refusing loudly names the route (CAIRN_BUS_HOME=<scratch>) and leaves the choice with the caller.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the house venv's editable install names the house checkout: measured on akienasus, direct_url.json reads file:///home/akien/cairn, from any cwd and with PYTHONPATH pinned elsewhere. A box with no editable install falls back to today's behaviour, noted.
challenge.prior_art: 1029d5146152 (a shutdown drains what it holds) and 99258e9bbdb1 (a client finding its stale bus draining uses it) soften a replace; neither stops a foreign root from sending one. b38af5fd1852 is the host-singleton ticket, and its loud-vs-quiet question open-cf43b673ac07 (Q#93) concerns a second COPY starting, not an old copy being shut down: a distinction, recorded.
challenge.real_collision: remote.py's docstring (decision 4: 'a bus started from another root ... _call shuts it down, starts one from this root') is narrowed: another root no longer replaces the LIVE bus. The outline check will say whether an outline line states decision 4 unqualified.

answers.falsifier: RED if a client whose class root is not the house root sends shutdown to a stale live bus, or if the house root stops replacing a stale live bus, or if a scratch home's stale bus stops being replaced.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator relayed it from measured evictions: the Dell's ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/0/stops.jsonl holds shutdown verbs 03:42:39Z-03:45:01Z from worktree proofs and a hollow; the replace path is cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py _replace
answers.how: In cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py, _replace (the one door both stale paths use) raises BusStale before sending shutdown when the home is the live home and this file's resolved class root is not the house root. The house root is CAIRN_BUS_CLIENT_HOUSE_ROOT if set, else the cairn distribution's direct_url.json editable url. Unknown house root: replace as today and note it. Red-first proof with exchange replaced.
answers.traces_to: Law 6 (the host's one bus is the house's; a worktree or hollow is not its owner and may not end it) and Law 7 (a refusal is loud and names its route, instead of a silent eviction measured at up to 4.9 GB maxrss per replace).
answers.what: A client running another checkout's code never shuts down the host's live bus: only the house root (the checkout the house venv's editable install points at) replaces a stale live bus, and any other root is refused loudly, naming both roots and the scratch-home route.

bullets.text: Dell stops.jsonl 03:42:39Z-03:48:29Z: 8 shutdown verbs in 6 minutes, from sail.py chart/cross, a reflection, worktree bin proofs and a hollow; one replace peaked at 4.9 GB maxrss. Roots ping-pong: each foreign root evicts, the house root evicts back.
Consequence: a hollow run at the live home now reds loudly at a stale bus instead of evicting it; giving hollow a scratch bus home is the tester's (cc_0's) sibling.
